overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating after adjourning its January 27 meeting; the notice and minutes allegations were declined as untimely. The Board must amend the minutes and certify.

allegations.summary: After the January 27 meeting adjourned, remaining members resumed discussing a West Road camping facility permit without a posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because a quorum of the Board discussed the West Road camping facility after the January 27 meeting adjourned, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated during the January 27 meeting on a topic (the camping facility) not listed on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, any allegation regarding the sufficiency of notice is untimely.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the approved minutes of the January 27 meeting were insufficiently detailed about the topics discussed.
allegations.key_passage: As the complaint was not filed until August 22, close to four months after the meeting, the allegation of insufficiently detailed minutes is untimely.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the January 27 minutes should have summarized the post-adjournment discussion.
allegations.key_passage: As the post-adjournment discussion occurred outside of the posted meeting of January 27, the Open Meeting Law did not require that minutes of the posted January 27 meeting include a summary of those deliberations.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board should have posted notice of the post-adjournment deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: We find a violation as explained in section I above precisely because the deliberation did not occur during a noticed meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days, amend the January 27 minutes to include a summary of the post-adjournment discussion, make clear it occurred after adjournment, and certify to the AG that this was done.
remedy_passage: We also order that within the next 30 days the Board amend the minutes of the January 27 meeting to include a summary of the discussion that occurred after the meeting was adjourned and to certify to our office that it has done so.
